scope: Same direct banded shift ODE as the failed centered case, changing only its discrete derivative to the one-point right-biased stencil. Physical/gauge PDE, hyperbolic operators, penalties, resolution/time/refinement controls and thresholds unchanged. A preliminary finite-grid Jacobian shows the centered outer mode grows with refinement, while right-biased spectra at N32/64/128/256 have negative dominant real parts. This motivates, but does not certify, the nonlinear trial.
controls: Same three spatial, fixed-grid timestep and independent 0/2/4 arithmetic-refinement controls as the centered ODE study. Retain failed centered cases; no comparing fields at their unequal failure times.
limitation: Right-biased regular nodal-origin closure has a parasitic static mode and is rejected. The present main study has half-cell regular-center grids and actual scri. Additional origin-layout controls remain distinct.
